summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in react-native-drago-callkit@0.0.0-stage
details: Package react-native-drago-callkit at version 0.0.0-stage ships only two files and exhibits no observable installer-harm behavior. There are no lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer secrets (environment, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no network calls to hardcoded author or third-party endpoints, no silent relay of caller-supplied data, no persistence or backdoor mechanism, and no credentials shipped in the tarball. The version string and tiny file count are consistent with a pre-release staging placeholder.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
